name: Company TheHive instance (read-only query API)
operator: The organisation running V3LUM (module setting thehive_sightings_url)
tier_rationale: Instance operated by the company or a contracted processor (A12: disclosure 'internal', allowed at TLP:RED); community or shared instances must be registered as third-party providers instead.

reliability.justification: Team-operated case platform: cases and observables are the team's own triage records; reliability follows the case and its markings.

thehive.description: TheHive API key of a read-only least-privilege service account (Authorization: Bearer)
thehive.plan_hint: a read-only least-privilege service account of the company instance (A12); keys with manage* permissions get a warning

query.title: TheHive observables and the cases holding them via POST /api/v1/query (read-only search)

terms.quote: disclosure='internal' (allowed at TLP:RED) applies only to instances operated by the company or a contracted processor.

query.notes: Quote: binding council text (A12). Own data on the team's TheHive 5/6 (research C0735; synthetic fixtures for the TheHive 6.0 OpenAPI). Read-only: POST /api/v1/query with listObservable/filter/case/page operations and GET /api/v1/user/current only; never creates or updates cases, alerts or observables. Results keep the case/observable TLP and PAP.

notes: Owned by batch p1-G07-2 (P348 thehive_sightings, P2 adapter of A12). Disabled unless the module setting thehive_sightings_url (https) and key 'thehive' are configured; TLS verification always on (setting ca_bundle). A core setting thehive_url (like misp_url/opencti_url) is requested from the core; until it exists the module setting carries the URL (env V3LUM_THEHIVE_SIGHTINGS_URL).
